svg.title: R-dorm-P - Crew Quarters - plan
svg.text: Shared sleeping quarters for enlisted crew off watch: bunk beds with a personal locker each, a common table for
meals and cards, and a desk nook for letters and study.
Bunk row on the north wall
Bunks on the east and south walls
Single bunk on the port side
Snacks and drinks at the crew table
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
